caption.en:
The stock audit checklist.

25 questions to run on your inventory — before your next stocktake.

Most stock problems are discovered too late. An audit finds them early.

25 questions across 5 categories:
• Visibility — can you answer "where is my stock?" in 10 seconds?
• Movements — can you trace every transfer to a user and timestamp?
• Permissions — is the creator different from the approver?
• AI & documents — are uncertain fields flagged, never guessed?
• Integration readiness — is the source of truth defined for each data type?

Free download. No demo required.

👉 Get the checklist — link in bio.
